The kit cannot change your height, voice, body shape, or clothing, and close physical inspection reveals the makeup.

effectDetails.title: Steve Cannot Sing

effectDetails.title: Establish Sovereign City
effectDetails.rules: Activates on the first day you begin construction. The settlement gains full governing authority, including the right to establish laws and collect taxes. It is protected by international law, which prevents it from being easily destroyed or annexed by other powers.

cloning_chamber.name: Cloning Chamber (Installation)
effects: Clone any willing humanoid once per month

effectDetails.title: Cloning
effectDetails.rules: Activates on a full action over one month. The subject must be a willing humanoid. Once the process is complete, the clone is an exact physical duplicate but with no memories or personality.

effectDetails.title: Consciousness Transfer
effectDetails.rules: The original can transfer their consciousness to the clone as a bonus action once per day. This transfers all memories and skills up to the point of transfer, but the clone cannot remember the act itself.

usage.activation: Activation requires a full action over one month and the presence of a willing humanoid subject.
usage.duration: Instantaneous effect upon completion, lasting until used or destroyed.
usage.endsWhen: Exhausted after one use per month; can be reinstalled in another location for future uses.

effectDetails.title: Blessing or Curse
effectDetails.rules: When the coin lands on its edge, roll a d20. If even, you gain a blessing chosen by the DM; if odd, you incur a curse. The effect is immediate and lasts until the next dawn.

effectDetails.title: Daily Re-roll
effectDetails.rules: The coin flips again each dawn, providing another chance to alter your fate. However, once it has landed on its edge during this period, further rolls do not change unless you take a short rest.

usage.activation: Passive effect; no activation required. The coin flips on its own at dawn.
usage.duration: Instantaneous; re-flips each dawn.
usage.endsWhen: Destroyed by a successful DC 15 Con saving throw, or when the adventurer takes a short rest after it has landed on its edge.

effectDetails.rules: The ore's adamantine core resists all attempts at transmutation or magical damage. Any spell cast on it with the transmutation school fails, and it gains resistance to all damage types except psychic.
